description: Sri Lanka Customs - The Rates  of Exchange effective from 05.03.2018 to 11.03.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It sets new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges, and rescinds a previous notification. This content pertains to the establishment of a regulatory framework and compliance requirements for customs operations, which falls squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for regulatory matters and statutory instruments.
